nodes.summary: For an element $t$ of a group $G$, this is the set of involutions of $G$ that commute with $t$: the elements $s \in G$ of order $2$ with $st = ts$.
nodes.title: Involutions commuting with an element

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$ there is a bound $N$ such that every finite simple group $G$ containing an involution $t$ that commutes with at most $n$ involutions of $G$ (counting $t$ itself) has order at most $N$.
nodes.title: Finitely many finite simple groups with an involution commuting with few involutions

nodes.summary: This is the statement that for every natural number $n$ there is a bound $N$ such that every finite simple group $G$ containing an involution $t$ that commutes with at most $n$ involutions of $G$ (counting $t$ itself) has order at most $N$. Bounding the order expresses "only finitely many such groups up to isomorphism".
nodes.title: Strunkov's finiteness question for simple groups (Kourovka 11.96(a))

nodes.summary: A field $P$ is locally finite when, for every finite subset $s$ of $P$, the subfield of $P$ generated by $s$ is finite.
nodes.title: Locally finite fields (Kourovka 18.59)

nodes.summary: There exist a natural number $n$ and an infinite simple group $G$ containing an involution $t$ that commutes with at most $n$ involutions of $G$ (counting $t$ itself). This answers Kourovka Problem 11.96(b) in the negative.
nodes.title: An infinite simple group with an involution commuting with few involutions

nodes.summary: This is the statement that for every natural number $n$, no infinite simple group $G$ contains an involution $t$ that commutes with at most $n$ involutions of $G$ (counting $t$ itself).
nodes.title: Strunkov's question on infinite simple groups (Kourovka 11.96(b))

nodes.summary: There is no periodic group $G$ that contains an involution, in which all involutions are conjugate, and for which there is an infinite locally finite field $P$ of characteristic $2$ such that the centralizer of every involution $i$ of $G$ is isomorphic to $\langle i \rangle \times \mathrm{PSL}_2(P)$. can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
